Directions: Read and study the sources about the oil industry in Louisiana. Then use the four sources and your knowledge of social studies to answer each question that follows.
Title: Source 1: Jennings Field (Early 1900s)
Content: Oil was discovered at Jennings Field on `text(September 21, 1901)`. The discovery started an “oil rush.” This picture shows many oil wells in Jennings, Louisiana. These wells pumped oil from a huge oil field. An oil field is a lake of oil deep underground. More than `7text(,)000` barrels of oil were produced `text(every day)` at the Jennings oil field.
